column1: # RECOIL has no Nintendo console formats. Evidence is RGBDS rgbgfx (MIT, built from source at d73a05a and run as a black box): `rgbgfx -r` renders the same files, and the source PNGs of the generated sets are pixel-exact oracles after RGB555 quantization. Transparent colors are composited onto the shared grey 0xc0c0c0.
